CITY OF ALHAMBRA PLANNING COMMISSION
  ACTION MINUTES

  Regular Meeting
  January 19, 2021

A.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER:  7:01 P.M. via video conference and teleconference

B.  ROLL CALL:
  Present:  Messina, Moreno Garcia, Olson, Sahu, Tang, Tsujii, Wang, E. Garcia,
  Gardea

  Absent:  None

  Commissioner Tang arrived at 7:08 PM

  Staff Present: Vanessa Reynoso, Deputy Director, Paul Lam, Principal Planner, Mario
  Arellano, Assistant Planner, Werner Abrego, Assistant Planner, Erica Vega,
  Deputy City Attorney

C.  FLAG SALUTE:  Led by President Gardea

D.  CONSENT AGENDA:

  There were no Consent Agenda items.

E.  PUBLIC HEARINGS:

  ITEM 1:  CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT CUP-20-05
  • 129 West Main Street
  • Request: This is an application for a Conditional Use Permit to allow
  an on-premise alcoholic beverage license (Type 41) for the sale of
  beer and wine in conjunction with meal service in an existing
  restaurant located in the CBD-DRD (Central Business District-
  Downtown Revitalization District) zone.
  • Recommended Action:  Adopt Resolution 21-04 approving
  Conditional Use Permit CUP-20-05, subject to the Conditions of
  Approval.
  • Assistant Planner Mario Arellano provided staff presentation.
  • Public Comments: There were none.
  • Commissioner Comments:
  Commissioner Sahu verified with Staff that the Conditions of
  Approval were standard conditions for a CUP and there were no
  unique conditions for this Applicant.
  President Gardea noted Condition of Approval PD2 needed
  1
  1/19/21
   correction.
  Commissioner Moreno Garcia verified with Staff that there were no
  concerns from the Police Department.
  Commissioner Wang clarified the length of time the CUP would be
  valid.
  Commissioner Sahu verified with Staff the status of the Applicant’s
  Type 41 ABC license.
  President Gardea verified with Staff there was an overconcentration
  of alcohol licenses by ABC standards and that a Statement of Public
  Convenience and Necessity was not applicable.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Conditional Use Permit CUP-20-05 with Condition of
  Approval PD2 to be amended as follows: “PD2: At all times when the
  premises are open for business the sale of beer and wine shall be
  made only in conjunction with the sale of food to the person ordering
  the beverage.”
  •  Moved by Commissioner Moreno Garcia, Seconded by Commissioner
  Sahu.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 9-0
  Ayes:  Messina, Moreno Garcia, Olson, Sahu, Tang, Tsujii, Wang, E.
  Garcia, Gardea
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent: None

•  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio and video
  recordings of the discussion are available here:

  https://drive.google.com/file/d/1iw5dbLR3qKUPW3ysfFhdqlVz4CARcPlW/view
  Video:
  https://drive.google.com/file/d/1gFPzlDVc1o0ZAYp6l1rrSMvUoD-m57Ae/view

ITEM 2:  CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT CUP-20-02
  • 112 West Main Street
  • Request: This is an application for a Conditional Use Permit to allow
  an on-premise alcoholic beverage license (Type 41) for the sale of
  beer and wine in conjunction with meal service in an existing
  restaurant located in the CBD-DRD (Central Business District-
  Downtown Revitalization District) zone.
  • Recommended Action:  Adopt Resolution 21-03 approving
  Conditional Use Permit CUP-20-02, subject to the Conditions of
  Approval.

  2
  1/19/21
   •  Assistant Planner Werner Abrego provided staff presentation and
  noted Condition of Approval PD2 required a correction in a manner
  identical to the correction made to Item 1.
  •  Public Comments: There were none.
  •  Commissioner Comments:
  Commissioner Moreno Garcia had questions regarding the storage,
  access, and visibility of the beer and wine.
  Commissioner Messina noted one of the business owners was a
  fellow Soroptimist.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Conditional Use Permit CUP-20-02 with Condition of
  Approval PD2 to be amended as follows: “PD2: At all times when the
  premises are open for business the sale of beer and wine shall be
  made only in conjunction with the sale of food to the person ordering
  the beverage.”
  •  Moved by Commissioner Messina, Seconded by Commissioner Olson.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 9-0
  Ayes:  Messina, Moreno Garcia, Olson, Sahu, Tang, Tsujii, Wang, E.
  Garcia, Gardea
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent: None

  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio and video

F.  DIRECTOR’S REPORT:

  Deputy Director Vanessa Reynoso informed the Planning Commission of two (2) East
  Main Street workshops to be held on January 21, 2021, and a Zoning Code Update
  workshop to be held on January 23, 2021.
